rows.text:
Ever since the Phantasmoon Games were created by The Laughter, each time the Phantasmoon is full, the glorious season arrives where Supplicants beat each other bloody. Cosmic powerhouses seeking the Elation either put on spectacular shows for the masses, drowning millions in comedy and fable, or throw all dignity out the window, going at each other tooth and nail while the crowd roars with laughter from the stands.

In short, whether it's the victor or the Supplicant who gains the Strength of Elation, every Phantasmoon Games throughout history has been known to pull off some pretty wild stunts. Today, I have specially selected several documented (and some suspected) traces of victors whose exploits wreaked havoc across the universe, for your amusement.


Fluffy
According to wild tales, the conductor of the Astral Express wasn't always fluffy, not until a certain victor of the Phantasmoon Games wished for more Fluffies to populate the universe. However, in a later interview, the conductor denied this claim.

Parable of the Elation
Legend has it that in Amber Era 2144, Adrian Spencer Smith won the Phantasmoon Games through unknown means. Everyone held their breath, waiting for the miracle he would create, but a minute later, nothing happened in the universe. Rumors claim he wove a parable using the divine power of the Elation, but with his disappearance, this rumor can no longer be verified.

The Vitality of Words
In 2146 AE, a massive textual escape occurred simultaneously across the universe. On more than ten thousand planets, written words gained life and the ability to move, fleeing from information receptacles such as books and screens. The phenomenon ceased after one minute, resulting in the loss of massive amounts of technological achievements and historical documents. In the Intelligentsia Guild's database, data related to the Eden of Blessed Insight was lost on a massive scale. It is speculated that the victorious Supplicant of this incident was either one of The Cremators or Riddlers.

Mourning Segmentum
In 2147 AE, multiple Space Fissures appeared across several star systems including Lafcadio, Epsilon, and Heldorin, continuously emitting "cries" into the vacuum. Any living beings within 1 light-year of their vicinity would uncontrollably weep until they were outside the range. The timing of this incident coincided with the end of the Phantasmoon Games, though Intelligentsia Guild has not confirmed any correlation between the two. On the inevitable route passing through Epsilon's Mourning Segmentum, the IPC selected a new site for Interastral Peace Entertainment's headquarters, which would later become known as Astropolis.

Reincarnation
In 2157 AE, a Doctor of Chaos won the Phantasmoon Games and attempted to create a universe with an afterlife to dilute the sense of emptiness that death brings to life. In Lafcadio and several surrounding star systems, "phantoms of death" from the past crowded every planet. This phenomenon lasted for several system hours, causing severe disruption. It is said that the figure of a certain Astral Express Navigator briefly appeared on Adlivun.

An Anecdote
Rumor has it that a high-ranking executive at the Interastral Peace Corporation once participated in the Phantasmoon Games in their youth and emerged victorious. However, like countless other realities rewritten by the power of Elation, Planarcadia's historical records contain no trace of this event. Based on timeline, age, and operational scope, massive evidence points toward Oswaldo from the Marketing Development Department, but he has never responded to these claims.
